adds.title: Commissioner for LGBTIQ+ Communities (Gender and Sexuality Commissioner) and Victorian Equal Opportunity and Human Rights Commission
adds.summary: Victoria maintains a Commissioner for LGBTIQA+ Communities to advocate for the rights, safety and wellbeing of trans and gender diverse people, with Joe Ball, a transgender man, appointed on 23 September 2024 for a three-year term to advise government on safe and inclusive policies, services and programs and to lead implementation of Pride in our Future, Victoria's 10-year LGBTIQA+ equality plan.

adds.title: AB v Western Australia - High Court of Australia (2012)
adds.summary: On 6 October 2011 the High Court of Australia held under the Gender Reassignment Act 2000 (WA) that female-to-male persons who had bilateral mastectomies and androgen therapy and lived as men were entitled to recognition certificates as male without hysterectomy, oophorectomy or genital reconstructive surgery, establishing that Western Australia permits legal gender change without sterilisation or genital surgery.

adds.title: Births, Deaths, Marriages Registration Amendment (Sex or Gender Changes) Act 2024
adds.summary: Western Australia assented on 26 September 2024 to the Births, Deaths and Marriages Registration Amendment (Sex or Gender Changes) Act 2024 (Act No. 031 of 2024) amending births, deaths and marriages registration law on sex or gender changes.
